      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: |-
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressFormValidation
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, accepted for backward
            compatibility. The value is normalized before it is stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of
            whitespace collapsed to a single space, it is upper-cased, and common
            street-type abbreviations are expanded as whole words (ST->STREET,
            RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE), e.g. '  12  main st ' is stored as '12 MAIN
            STREET'. Optional: an owner is accepted when it supplies an address in
            EITHER the flat form here OR a non-blank structured 'addressLine1'. On
            the response this holds the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' (with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present) when structured fields were supplied, otherwise
            the normalized flat address. When supplied directly it must not be
            blank after normalization.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, street-type
            abbreviations expanded). An owner is accepted when it supplies a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' or a flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Normalized with the same rules as 'addressLine1'. When present it is
            appended to the normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space,
            to form the composed 'address' returned on the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.Email
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present,
            so an owner created without a postcode stays valid. When present it
            must be valid for the owner's city: for a city with a known region
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099) the postcode must fall in that region's inclusive range; a
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned exactly as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. A date later than the server's current date is rejected.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional.
            When present it is used to derive the owner's read-only ageBand,
            computed against the owner's registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:

          description: >-
            Write-only request flag; it is not persisted or returned. When
            another owner already shares this owner's lastName and postcode (the
            same household), the create is rejected as a household duplicate (409)

            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false

              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              type: string
              enum:

              example: 'EMAIL'

              title: Telephone display
              description: >-

            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'

            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').

          maxLength: 20

        email:

            returned exactly as given.

          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'

          title: Registration date

              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                the same household: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode share it automatically. Absent for owners
                created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email the
                stored lower-cased form (empty when absent) and householdId the
                shared household identifier (empty when the owner does not belong
                to a shared household). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict
                only when this whole key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership score. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email
                is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                time (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 for a household of three or
                more members; adds 3 for tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

              example: 4
              readOnly: true

              description: >-

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: |-
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressFormValidation
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the lastName to form the read-only
            salutation.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, accepted for backward
            compatibility. The value is normalized before it is stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of
            whitespace collapsed to a single space, it is upper-cased, and common
            street-type abbreviations are expanded as whole words (ST->STREET,
            RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE), e.g. '  12  main st ' is stored as '12 MAIN
            STREET'. Optional: an owner is accepted when it supplies an address in
            EITHER the flat form here OR a non-blank structured 'addressLine1'. On
            the response this holds the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' (with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present) when structured fields were supplied, otherwise
            the normalized flat address. When supplied directly it must not be
            blank after normalization.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, street-type
            abbreviations expanded). An owner is accepted when it supplies a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' or a flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Normalized with the same rules as 'addressLine1'. When present it is
            appended to the normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space,
            to form the composed 'address' returned on the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'

            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.Email
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present,
            so an owner created without a postcode stays valid. When present it
            must be valid for the owner's city: for a city with a known region
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099) the postcode must fall in that region's inclusive range; a
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned exactly as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. A date later than the server's current date is rejected.

            computed against the owner's registrationDate.

            another owner already shares this owner's lastName and postcode (the
            same household), the create is rejected as a household duplicate (409)
            unless this flag is true, in which case the owner is created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.

            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-

              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                the same household: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode share it automatically. Absent for owners
                created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email the
                stored lower-cased form (empty when absent) and householdId the
                shared household identifier (empty when the owner does not belong
                to a shared household). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict
                only when this whole key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique at creation time.
              type: integer

              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:

              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership score. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email
                is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                time (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 for a household of three or

                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-

              readOnly: true

              type: string
              enum:

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets

              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: |-
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressFormValidation
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it is combined with the lastName to form the read-only
            salutation ('<title> <lastName>'); when absent the salutation is
            just the lastName.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, accepted for backward
            compatibility. The value is normalized before it is stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of
            whitespace collapsed to a single space, it is upper-cased, and common
            street-type abbreviations are expanded as whole words (ST->STREET,
            RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE), e.g. '  12  main st ' is stored as '12 MAIN
            STREET'. Optional: an owner is accepted when it supplies an address in
            EITHER the flat form here OR a non-blank structured 'addressLine1'. On
            the response this holds the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' (with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present) when structured fields were supplied, otherwise
            the normalized flat address. When supplied directly it must not be
            blank after normalization.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, street-type
            abbreviations expanded). An owner is accepted when it supplies a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' or a flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Normalized with the same rules as 'addressLine1'. When present it is
            appended to the normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space,
            to form the composed 'address' returned on the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.Email
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present,
            so an owner created without a postcode stays valid. When present it
            must be valid for the owner's city: for a city with a known region
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099) the postcode must fall in that region's inclusive range; a
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned exactly as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. A date later than the server's current date is rejected.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional.
            When present it is used to derive the owner's read-only ageBand,
            computed against the owner's registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag; it is not persisted or returned. When
            another owner already shares this owner's lastName and postcode (the
            same household), the create is rejected as a household duplicate (409)
            unless this flag is true, in which case the owner is created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes separated by spaces (e.g. '+61412345678' is shown as
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the E.164
                form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of
                owners already in that city when this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier linking owners that belong to
                the same household: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode share it automatically. Absent for owners
                created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email the
                stored lower-cased form (empty when absent) and householdId the
                shared household identifier (empty when the owner does not belong
                to a shared household). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict
                only when this whole key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership score. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email
                is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                time (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 for a household of three or
                more members; adds 3 for tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created, flagging a
                bulk signup; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate

I added a `salutation` feature to the PetClinic REST app, following the existing derived-field conventions (like `displayName`/`initials`).
